acceptance_checks.given: an initialized legacy Jin root has no onboarding record
acceptance_checks.then: startup SHALL enter ready without presenting the guide

acceptance_checks.given: a fresh installation with no explicit or persisted root
acceptance_checks.then: startup SHALL enter first_run without creating the default Jin root
startup SHALL restore its persisted step and selected root
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Rust state round-trip and crash-resume tests

acceptance_checks.given: the effective existing root is unavailable
acceptance_checks.then: startup SHALL expose recovery without starting root-dependent services
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Rust resolution/retry tests and native scheduler startup review

acceptance_checks.when: the user selects an acceptable candidate
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL persist selection without initializing the candidate

acceptance_checks.given: a candidate is a file or non-empty uninitialized directory
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL return a validation error
Jin SHALL initialize the selected root before marking setup complete
Jin SHALL retain resumable in-progress state
Jin SHALL request native restart after durable completion
acceptance_checks.verify_method: testable restart outcome and native command wiring review

acceptance_checks.then: root-dependent frontend controllers SHALL remain disconnected
acceptance_checks.verify_method: frontend boot registration and bridge-error retry tests

acceptance_checks.then: focus SHALL move to the active step heading
appearance controls SHALL use existing persisted preferences
acceptance_checks.verify_method: controller tests and browser persistence review

acceptance_checks.given: 320, 390, 760, or 1440 CSS pixel windows and enlarged text
acceptance_checks.then: guide content SHALL remain reachable without horizontal clipping
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Playwright snapshots, geometry, scrolling, keyboard focus and screenshots

acceptance_checks.when: the user selects a valid replacement
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL initialize and persist it and restart without replaying onboarding
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Rust recovery tests, frontend recovery test and browser walkthrough

acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL preserve the environment path as authoritative and locked
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Rust resolver tests and recovery controller inspection
